name: Rick Thompson
source:
A cop and a freak-quency guardian whose job is to keep freak-quency away from the public eye. He isn't a freak-quency player, but still works to protect the game because of a deal he made. He seeks to kill the perpetrator behind his sister's death.

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29640]Lemma Soft Thread[/url]]
